age: Pancreata from 12-week-old male C57BL/6NJR mice (Janvier, Saint Berthewin Cedex, France) or 12-week-old male C57BL/6NTAC mice (Taconic, Lille Skensved, Denmark) were inflated with Liberase (Roche, Hvidovre, Denmark), excised and incubated at 37 °C to allow digestion.
cell_type: Islets were handpicked and cultured for 1 day in 10 ml RPMI 1640 medium (Lonza) with 11 mmol/l d-Glucose supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS; Biosera, Herlev, Denmark) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin (100 U/ml penicillin, 100 μg/ml streptomycin) (P/S; Gibco, Life Technologies, Roskilde, Denmark).
